content.title: Admission requirements for Gonzaga?
content.text: I'm a junior and I've been really interested in applying to Gonzaga. Can somebody fill me in on the admission requirements for this university? Thanks!2 years agoGonzaga University is a great choice! Here's an overview of the general admission requirements:1. Application: Gonzaga uses the Common Application, and you will need to submit this along with the required materials.2. Essay: A personal statement is required, and you'll have several prompts to choose from on the Common Application. Gonzaga also has an optional supplement essay. While it's not required, writing this essay can demonstrate your genuine interest in the school.3. High School Transcript: Submit your official high school transcript showing coursework completed through your junior year.4. Courses and GPA: Gonzaga typically looks for applicants who have completed a challenging course load in high school, including a good mix of honors and AP/IB courses. There is no minimum GPA requirement, but the average GPA of admitted students is around 3.7-4.0 (unweighted).5. Test Scores: Gonzaga University is currently test-optional, so submitting SAT or ACT scores is not required. However, you can choose to submit your scores if you think they will strengthen your application.6. Letters of Recommendation: Gonzaga typically requires one letter of recommendation from a teacher who knows you well academically. You may also submit an optional letter from another source, such as a mentor or coach.7. Extracurricular Activities: While not strictly required, a strong list of extracurricular activities will help you stand out. Gonzaga values applicants who show commitment and leadership in their schools and communities.8. Application Deadlines: Gonzaga currently offers Early Action (non-binding) which has a deadline of November 15, and Regular Decision which has a deadline of February 1.These admission requirements are relevant for the majority of undergraduate applicants, although specific programs or majors might have their own unique requirements. Be sure to check the Gonzaga University website and connect with the admissions office if you have any questions or special circumstances.
